create_CoTrackerData: create a CoTrackerData dataclass instance to store video tracks with trajectory and visibility tensors
collate_fn_batch: collate a batch of CoTrackerData samples by stacking video, trajectory, and visibility tensors together
collate_fn_train_batch: collate a training batch of CoTrackerData samples including valid masks, transforms, and augmented video tensors
try_to_cuda_tensor: move a torch tensor to the cuda device by converting to float and calling cuda
dataclass_to_cuda_dataclass: move all tensor fields of a CoTrackerData dataclass to the cuda device in place
